about: A server that lets AI assistants look at and query several kinds of databases.

prs.title: SQLite tables show which columns can be empty the right way round
prs.broken: Describing a SQLite table showed it backwards. Columns that must have a value were marked as allowed to be empty, and the others the opposite.
prs.changed: I flipped the check so it reports the same way it does for PostgreSQL.
prs.matters: Anyone reading a table's layout, person or assistant, gets the truth about which fields are required.

prs.title: Same-named PostgreSQL tables in different schemas stay separate
prs.broken: When two schemas had a table with the same name, as every Supabase project does, describing it mixed both into one made-up table. Naming the schema returned nothing at all.
prs.changed: I made it find the one table the name actually points to, and look only at that table's columns, indexes and keys.
prs.matters: The description matches the real table, so queries written from it work.
